content:
Emperor Smart Solutions — Website Chatbot Knowledge Base
Document type: RAG knowledge base
Product: Website Chatbot
Provider: Emperor Smart Solutions
Version: 1.0
Last updated: 2026-10-30
Language: English
Scope: Product information, setup, pricing, subscriptions, support, and integrations

CHUNK-001 | Product overview:
The Emperor Smart Solutions Website Chatbot is a chatbot that a business can add to its website. It helps website visitors ask questions and receive answers about that business's services, service types, pricing, packages, and other approved training information. Intended for business-related enquiries rather than general-purpose chat. Provider is Emperor Smart Solutions.

CHUNK-002 | Main purpose and visitor experience:
Visitors can ask questions about services, types of services, pricing, packages, and relevant business questions. Instead of looking through multiple pages, visitors get direct answers in a chat interface.

CHUNK-003 | Business-specific scope:
Chatbot is strictly designed to answer questions related to the business information provided during training. It will not invent answers; if unknown, it explains that the requested information is not available and suggests contacting the business.

CHUNK-004 & CHUNK-005 | Chatbot training & Approval:
Can be trained with business-specific Q&As, service descriptions, prices, and packages. All content is reviewed and approved by the business before training is finalized.

CHUNK-006 | Account and bot limits:
Each standard subscription includes ONE account only and ONE chatbot only. Additional accounts or additional bots are not included in the standard subscription.

CHUNK-007 | Seven-day free trial:
Emperor Smart Solutions offers a 7-day free trial of its Website Chatbot product.

CHUNK-008 | Monthly subscription:
Website Chatbot monthly subscription costs ₹999 for one month. Includes 1 account and 1 chatbot.

CHUNK-009 | Six-month subscription:
Costs ₹5,999 for a 6-month term. Includes 1 account and 1 chatbot.

CHUNK-010 | Annual subscription:
Costs ₹8,999 for 12 months. Includes 1 account and 1 chatbot. Saves ₹2,989 compared to 12 separate monthly payments. Equivalent monthly cost is approximately ₹749.92.

CHUNK-011 | Pricing Summary:
Monthly: ₹999/mo | 6-Month: ₹5,999 for 6 months | Annual: ₹8,999 for 12 months (Lowest total cost for full year). All plans include 1 account and 1 chatbot. 7-day free trial available.

CHUNK-012 | Upgrades:
Customers can upgrade billing subscriptions to longer-term plans from the dashboard.

CHUNK-013 | HTML Integration:
Added using provided HTML integration code pasted into the website header or before </body> tag without rebuilding the website.

CHUNK-014 | Google Search Console:
Can be used separately with the website for search analytics; does not track chatbot conversations.

CHUNK-015 | Help & Support:
Dedicated Help & Support section inside the platform to raise queries and report issues regarding account, bots, or billing.

CHUNK-016 | Examples & Guidelines:
Answers only from approved business knowledge. No invented prices or policies.
